selection: Sort eligible training records by source_index, random.Random(42).sample 32, then sort selected IDs; freeze before model load
loss_comparison: model.eval + no_grad, same 32 training samples/order/pairing, sum(batch_mean_loss * shifted_valid_target_tokens) / sum(valid_target_tokens)
learning_rate_schedule: constant; reuse smoke lr=1e-4, no scheduler
scope: New LoRA from frozen base, at most32 updates. No truncation of formal data, no long-example training, no validation/final examples or EX evaluation.
